name: RC-B10-0143/2026 – After § 16 – Am 15/1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on four years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine and European contributions to a just peace and sustained security for Ukraine
part_text: 16a. Strongly condemns the use of sexual and gender-based violence as a weapon of war and stresses that this constitutes a war crime; also condemns sexual and gender-based violence in the transit centres in Ukraine and across the EU; regrets the fact that the Temporary Protection Directive1a is interpreted so narrowly that many women who have fled Russia’s war of aggression cannot access abortion care or other sexual and reproductive health treatments, including treatment following sexual abuse; reiterates its call, in its resolution of 29 February 20241b, on the Commission to review the directive in order to ensure that all Member States are obliged to offer the same care that women could otherwise receive in Ukraine; \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_ 1a Council Directive 2001/55/EC of 20 July 2001 on minimum standards for giving temporary protection in the event of a mass influx of displaced persons and on measures promoting a balance of efforts between Member States in receiving such persons and bearing the consequences thereof (OJ L 212, 7.8.2001, p. 12, ELI:[http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2001/55/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/dir/2001/55/oj)). 1b European Parliament resolution of 29 February 2024 on the need for unwavering EU support for Ukraine, after two years of Russia’s war of aggression against Ukraine (OJ C, C/2024/6745, 26.11.2024, ELI: [http://data.europa.eu/eli/C/2024/6745/oj](http://data.europa.eu/eli/C/2024/6745/oj)).
